subject: Link shiny drop down choices to columns in dataset without using the dataset column names as choices

messages.author: 371abfcac77b8e14
messages.subject: Link shiny drop down choices to columns in dataset without using the dataset column names as choices
parts:
Hi,

I would like to have a drop down menu that allows the user select an independent variable for a barplot
Using the original column names as choices is not very informative for the user though (i.e. d1, X, q11_7_1)
How can I insert custom choice names but still have them be tied to the columns in the data set? i.e. have choice: Gender correspond to column name d1 from the dataset

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(shiny)

shinyApp(
ui= fluidPage(
    titlePanel("Average Satisfaction for each Independent Variable"),
    selectInput("perc", "Please Select an Independent Variable:", choices=colnames(fs)),
    plotOutput("plot1"),
 
    mainPanel(
        )
    ),

server = function(input,output){
  output$plot1<-renderPlot({barplot(sapply(split(fs$q1_7,fs[[input$perc]]),mean),ylab="Satisfaction")})
}
)
```
i've attached the dataset for reference. q1_7 represents satisfaction. Thank you!
